content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lexington

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP credential requires a specific combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility requirements to confirm you meet both the educational background and hours of hands-on project work needed to apply. Granite PM Academy's team can answer qualification questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend sessions from anywhere in Kentucky on a schedule that fits your work and personal commitments. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full curriculum required by PMI in an interactive, real-world format.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process and confirms you have met all prerequisites before you proceed to the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence in the PMP body of knowledge. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the four-hour, 200-question exam on your preferred date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP, commit to earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a standard three-year renewal cycle. Stay current with project-management practices through continuing education, conference attendance, volunteer work, or additional certifications to keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
